data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Poor Customer Service](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/688b9a4b9ab0f7f783134372)

I really wanted to love this shelf, but the photos are incredibly misleading — it doesn't sit flush against the wall, and the scale looks totally different in person. I bought both sizes and was planning to use them in a newly renovated space, but construction delays meant I didn’t open the larger one until just outside the 30-day return window. It’s completely unused and still in its original packaging aside from being unboxed.

I reached out to customer service explaining the situation and asking for store credit, but was met with a flat “no” after waiting over two days for a response. For a $120 shelf, I expected higher quality and more understanding. I’m keeping the smaller one, but regret this purchase overall. I'm very much inclined to never shop here again and to tell my family and interior design friends to avoid.

July 31, 2025

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 6, 2025

Hi Victoria,

Thank you for reaching out to us and sharing your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused regarding your shelf and our previous response—it’s never our intention to leave you feeling unheard.

We understand that construction delays can complicate timing. However, since your request is outside the 30-day return policy, we are unable to process a return for the larger shelf.

We also appreciate your feedback about the product images and scale, and we’ll be sure to share this with our team. Thank you for your patience, and we look forward to assisting you further.
